title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Schedule of Tuition Fee Charges for Cancellation/Drop and Withdrawal
For a complete listing of fees, refer to
Fees
and
Refund of Fees
for complete refund regulations. For a complete list of deadline dates, refer to the
Academic Dates
.
Important Definitions:
Cancellation:
Cancelling registration before the academic term has begun.
Drop:
Dropping a course(s) but remain registered in other(s) after the academic term has begun.
Withdraw:
Withdrawing from
all
courses after the academic term has begun.
Course Rate:
Equivalent to the cost of 1.0 credit as approved by the Board of Governors fee schedule.
Tuition Charges for Dropped/Withdrawn Courses:
All tuition charges for dropped/withdrawn courses are calculated based on the
Course Rate
. The Course Rate for any term is equivalent to the cost of 1.0 credits as approved by the Board of Governors (refer to
Fees
section).
Note:
full-time student tuition is capped at a maximum fee. Refer to the appropriate fee chart in the
Fees
section.
Charges are calculated based on Course Weight multiplied by the Course Rate, to the maximum.
Time Period
(Refer to
Academic Dates
for a complete list of deadline dates, subject to change)
Fee Charge for Dropping Course(s) but Remaining Registered in Other Courses *(see note)
Fee Charge for Withdrawal From All Courses * (see note)
Before term begins
No charge
No charge
Up to end of first week of the term (5th day)  for a 12-week course. Days 1-3 of the term for a 6-week course
No charge
No charge

10% per course @ course rate
10% per course @ course rate
After the last day for registration and adding of 6 or
12-week courses, but on or before the final day to drop for possible tuition adjustment
55% per course @ course rate
55% per course @ course rate
After the final day to drop for possible tuition adjustment
100% of term fees
100% of term fees
Two Term (full-year) Courses
- are both billed and
adjusted as if they were two separate courses charged each term, (i.e.,
if a two-term course is dropped after the last day to register and the
last day to add classroom courses in the winter term, the student would
be charged 100 percent of fall term and 55 percent of winter term).
Courses of Shorter Duration
- deadline dates are pro-rated for courses of shorter duration (i.e., 6-week, 7-week or 8-week courses).
* NOTE:
Students are responsible for all related, non-refundable fees (including Online Learning charges).
